coaching_interpretation.priority: Family-first travel and consolidation rather than trying to preserve a nominal five-to-six-touch week.
coaching_interpretation.default_training: No separate structured workout is required during the trip.
coaching_interpretation.hike_rule: If the sunrise hike occurs, record it on Garmin. A substantive hike is a meaningful aerobic, eccentric-leg, sleep-disruption and heat/cold-exposure dose and replaces rather than supplements training that day.
coaching_interpretation.island_rule: Island hopping, sun, boat transit, swimming, walking and heat exposure are life load. They inform hydration and recovery but are not converted into arbitrary workout targets.
coaching_interpretation.reentry_rule: The first post-travel bike decision requires fresh sleep, readiness, CNS, travel-fatigue and illness evidence. Do not assume immediate Enduro eligibility solely because the calendar is open.
coaching_interpretation.sabbath: Sunday 2026-08-09 remains a hard no-planned-exercise day.

next_evidence_needed: Whether and when the Kundasang sunrise hike will occur
Hike duration, elevation gain, terrain and RPE if completed
Actual sleep, walking load, heat exposure, hydration and illness status
Fresh Garmin and subjective readiness after returning
